name: wait
description: Wait without a deadline. Explicit targets are direct parent/children only; terminal targets return immediately. Waiting alone isn't completion; status=turn_completed means an interactive turn finished. With no targets, discovers parent/children, reviews/admissions, questions, lanes and own shells. any/all applies only to run completion; messages/replies, questions/answers, host input, lanes, parent termination and shell teardown interrupt either. Returns event runs and bounded correlated messages; presentation ACKs returned child output/messages only. Parent questions/idle/output excluded. Lane bodies/answers/input follow tools. Running shells stay sources; completion cites original call ID, no duplicate ToolResult. Non-error no_wait_sources explains absence: report status, don't poll. Lone run_id may return phase-only status with no output ACK.
